summary: Connect property allocations to pension liabilities, liquidity and governance. Review the course outline and build committee-ready investment outputs.
lede: Real estate investment for pension funds assesses property allocations against pension liabilities, liquidity needs and investment governance. For pension investment officers, trustees and portfolio analysts, the course covers mapping benefit-payment cash flows, testing rental and valuation assumptions, and building Excel liquidity ladders and scenarios. Participants also review fair-value evidence and sustainability indicators, then prepare allocation rationales and committee recommendations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, govern or report pension fund property exposure and need to connect investment evidence with liabilities, liquidity and committee decisions.
modules: Property Cash Flows and Pension Liabilities
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of pension fund investment or portfolio reporting, plus basic familiarity with property investment terminology. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel installed; no additional software installation is required.
